name: song-trivia-server
description: Server-authoritative multiplayer music guessing game (single room).

comments.optionalScaleDeps: Loaded lazily ONLY when the matching env var is set (see DEPLOY.md): '@socket.io/redis-adapter' + 'ioredis' (REDIS_URL, multi-instance), '@sentry/node' (SENTRY_DSN, error monitoring). 'pg' is a regular dependency now — with DATABASE_URL set it persists the song catalog + global leaderboard; without it both fall back gracefully.
